# Azure Messaging — Event Hubs & Service Bus Doctor

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's troubleshooting skill for the Azure Messaging SDKs: diagnose Event Hubs and Service Bus issues — connection failures, authentication errors, AMQP link detaches, idle timeouts, message and session lock loss, dead letters, duplicate events and checkpoint resets — with a six-step workflow (identify SDK version, check resource health, match the error, search Microsoft Learn, verify configuration, recommend the fix) and language-specific guides under the azure-diagnostics references.
